description: A PHP script for viewing requirements in a requirement specification within the TestLink project. It initializes the page, checks user permissions, loads specific requirement data, and displays the requirement details using a Smarty template.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used for flexible data storage

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class for rendering HTML views

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the arguments for the page, such as requirement spec ID and refresh flag

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure with requirement, project, and user rights information

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the requirement specification page
